name: prd-check
description: Check a Markdown PRD against your team's template and rules, and write a line-numbered report of what to fix.

interface.shortDescription: Check a PRD against your template
interface.longDescription: Parse a Markdown PRD, compare it with your team's PRD template and a small rule file, and produce a report that names the line, the rule, and the fix. Never edits the PRD.
